ios.desc:
PickleWatch turns your Apple Watch into an automatic pickleball tracker that detects and grades every swing — serve, drive, volley, dink, and smash — in real time. No phone needed.

Your Apple Watch becomes your personal pickleball coach, tracking every swing in real-time with zero setup required. Just tap start, play your game, and get instant insights to improve your technique. 

INTELLIGENT SWING ANALYSIS
  • Real-time motion tracking analyzes every shot you take
  • Instant color-coded feedback: green for perfect form, yellow for good technique, red for areas to improve
  • Automatic shot detection recognizes serves, drives, volleys, dinks, and overhead smashes
  • Smart coaching tips personalized to your playing style and skill level

COMPREHENSIVE PERFORMANCE TRACKING
  • Session summaries with detailed shot breakdowns and quality scores
  • Speed analysis shows your swing velocity and consistency trends
  • Progress tracking reveals improvement over time with clear, actionable data
  • Heart rate and calorie monitoring integrated with Apple Health

WORKS PERFECTLY FOR EVERY PLAYER
  • Beginner-friendly with encouraging feedback and fundamental tips
  • Intermediate players get technique refinement suggestions
  • Advanced players receive detailed analytics for competitive edge
  • Adaptive learning adjusts to your personal playing style

EFFORTLESS AND ACCURATE
  • 100% watch-only experience - leave your phone in your bag
  • No additional equipment or setup required
  • Works on any pickleball court, indoors or outdoors
  • Battery-efficient design for extended play sessions

MOTIVATIONAL INSIGHTS
  • Achievement system celebrates milestones and improvements
  • Streak tracking encourages consistent practice
  • Quality trend analysis shows exactly where you're improving
  • Session comparison helps you understand what makes your best games

PREMIUM FEATURES (Optional subscription)
  • Advanced shot analysis with trajectory patterns
  • Detailed progress charts and historical trends
  
Perfect for recreational players wanting to improve their game, coaches tracking student progress, or competitive players seeking every advantage. Start playing better pickleball today.

Download PickleWatch and transform every game into a coaching session.
